veranderings.voor: Albei lees jy van die kaart self af
veranderings.na: Jy lees albei van die kaart self af
veranderings.rede: Fronting 'Albei' with inversion reads stiffly for Grade 4; subject-first order is more natural and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.blok: Sê waar een plek teenoor 'n ander lê
veranderings.voor: en lê dus wes van die huis
veranderings.rede: Avoids repeating 'van die huis' twice in one sentence and matches the parallel 'noord daarvan' in the next sentence.

veranderings.blok: Die son wys die rigtings buite
veranderings.voor: sak teen die einde van die dag in die weste
veranderings.rede: 'Saans' is the natural counterpart of 'soggens' earlier in the sentence and replaces a wordy phrase without changing the meaning.

vlae.teks: Albei lees jy van die kaart self af.
vlae.rede: 'Albei' follows sentences about the key and the compass rose, but the block also introduced the north arrow, so a learner may read 'albei' as the compass rose and north arrow; clarifying the reference would mean guessing the intended content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
